The '''Azura system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Azuran stingcrawler]]s.<ref name="Unifying Force" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Azura system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-6.<ref name="TEA" />
